summary: Longer wait times due to staff shortage

updates.details: Wait times for SSH access are currently longer than usual. We apologise for any inconvenience.

Host reboots and some essential JASMIN network maintenance will take place early Thursday morning 13th August and cause brief interruption to many services and terminate user sessions. Work should be complete by 08:30 but should be considered at risk until 12:30.
